benefits.name: Bilt Travel hotel credit
benefits.qualifying: Bilt Travel hotel booking of 2+ nights paid with the Palladium card; the booking-period allowance applies.
benefits.note: Prepaid bookings show a reduced checkout charge; pay-at-hotel bookings get a statement credit after the stay (allow 8-10 weeks). No rollover. The 2027 package replaces it for most accounts (see upcoming changes). Prepaid bookings show only a reduced checkout charge, so use is confirmed by the person.

benefits.name: Annual Bilt Cash
benefits.qualifying: Primary account in good standing.
benefits.note: Granted at account opening and on each card anniversary under the 2026-10-27 terms; older marketing and reviews said January 1 / calendar year. Each Bilt Cash award expires at the end of the month 12 months after it was earned (11:59 p.m. Pacific), including already-earned 2026 cash; older sources said December 31 with up to $100 rollover. Shown in the Bilt wallet, not as a bank credit.

benefits.name: Priority Pass membership
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll; an eligible paid additional cardholder needs a separate membership.
benefits.qualifying: Participating lounges; the holder plus 2 complimentary guests. Restaurant credits are excluded in the cited review.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash earning option
benefits.qualifying: Eligible nonhousing everyday purchases earn 4% Bilt Cash alongside card points.
benefits.note: Applies to the current Flexible Bilt Cash mode.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash milestone
benefits.qualifying: $50 for every 25,000 qualifying Bilt Points earned toward elite status.
benefits.note: A program-wide benefit, not specific to this card.

benefits.name: Point Accelerator
benefits.enrollment_how: Activate it; Flexible mode is required under the current 2026 rules.
benefits.qualifying: Spend $200 of Bilt Cash to earn +1x on the next $5,000 of eligible everyday purchases; housing and specified excluded payments do not count.
benefits.note: Up to 5 activations per calendar year; an unused earning window expires December 31.

benefits.name: Housing points
benefits.qualifying: Eligible rent or mortgage payments plus a qualifying ratio of everyday spend.
benefits.note: Housing-only mode earns 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x or 1.25x when everyday spend reaches 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of the housing payment; below the first tier the stated floor is 250 points. Flexible mode lets you redeem $3 of Bilt Cash for 100 housing points, up to 1x. Points, not statement credits.

benefits.name: Rent Day and status-program access
benefits.qualifying: Offers shown in the Bilt app.
benefits.note: Points, booking access or partner discounts; a fixed guaranteed value was not found.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Grubhub / Seamless
benefits.qualifying: Eligible restaurant delivery; pickup, catering, alcohol and Wonder are excluded.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover. Delivered as an emailed promo code that expires at month-end.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Lyft
benefits.qualifying: Eligible rides.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover. Appears as a Lyft Pass balance that expires at month-end.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Walgreens
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Walgreens purchases.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover. Issued as a digital gift card in the Bilt app, valid 30 days.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Bilt Home Delivery
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Gopuff-powered Bilt orders.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Mobile Dining Checkout
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Bilt dining partners; one visit.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: dining experiences
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Bilt experiences.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: comedy experiences
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Bilt comedy experiences.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: fitness class
benefits.qualifying: One eligible class, including participating Barry's and SoulCycle locations.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Bilt Travel hotel
benefits.qualifying: Bilt Travel hotel booking of 2+ nights.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover. Monthly through 2026-12-31; $50 for Blue and Silver, $100 for Gold and Platinum. Prepaid bookings get a discount; pay-at-hotel bookings get a statement credit after the stay. Separate from the card's $400 hotel benefit.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Home Away From Home access
benefits.qualifying: Participating luxury hotels; for Gold and Platinum this access is a status benefit.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover. Costs $95 of Bilt Cash for one eligible booking a month for Blue and Silver members; property benefits vary.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: additional lounge guests
benefits.qualifying: Eligible extra lounge guests, $35 each, up to 2 ($70).
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover. The detailed terms describe LoungeKey guest passes; the support page wording differs (see disagreements).

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: BLADE
benefits.qualifying: Eligible airport-flight seats, $350 per seat; unused value is forfeited.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit. 2 redemptions per calendar year; resets January 1.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Blacklane
benefits.qualifying: Eligible rides.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit. One redemption per calendar year: $50 for Blue and Silver, $100 for Gold, $150 for Platinum.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Equinox
benefits.enrollment_how: Needs an active Equinox membership; link the accounts; minimum $50 redemption.
benefits.qualifying: Personal training, Pilates and spa; membership dues are not covered.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit. $75 for Blue, $100 for Silver, $150 for Gold and Platinum per half-year; unused credit expires.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Thumbtack
benefits.enrollment_how: Use the Bilt booking flow; evidence is required for eligible direct bookings.
benefits.qualifying: Qualifying Thumbtack jobs.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit. Up to $50 per half-year, one redemption each; applied as a checkout reduction or a verified digital-check reimbursement.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: Bilt Design Collection
benefits.qualifying: Eligible collection purchases.
benefits.note: Redeems existing Bilt Cash, not an extra credit on top of the $200 grant. Monthly allowances reset at midnight Pacific on the first, with no unused rollover.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash: transfer-bonus upgrade
benefits.qualifying: Eligible transfer promotion during an applicable Rent Day offer.
benefits.note: Redeems Bilt Cash for additional partner points; cost and value vary.

thresholds.unlocks: Bilt Silver status by fast track ($10,000 of qualifying spend or 50,000 qualifying points). Housing is excluded from the spend route.
Bilt Gold status by fast track ($25,000 of qualifying spend or 125,000 qualifying points). Housing is excluded from the spend route.
Bilt Platinum status by fast track ($50,000 of qualifying spend or 200,000 qualifying points). Housing is excluded from the spend route.
Acquisition offer: Bilt Gold after $4,000 of eligible nonhousing spend within 90 days (the initial February cohort had a 97-day window). Not permanent automatic Gold.

values.value: Up to $70 of Priority Pass statement credits (Bilt support page).
LoungeKey guest passes with short validity (detailed Bilt Cash terms).

upcoming_changes.summary: From the first card anniversary on or after 2027-01-01, $600 of annual Bilt Cash replaces the $200 cash plus $400 hotel package, unless the customer makes the permitted legacy election. $600 is not the current allowance.
Bilt Cash hotel redemptions move from monthly to a twice-yearly structure; this is separate from the card's $400 hotel benefit.
A $5 a month parking redemption is labeled 'coming soon' on Bilt support and is not counted as an available benefit.
